description: Convert between Unix epoch time and ISO 8601. Accepts epoch seconds or milliseconds (detected by magnitude) or any ISO 8601 date-time, and returns all forms plus the weekday. Call it with no arguments to get the current UTC time — a model has no clock of its own.

value.description: Epoch seconds, epoch milliseconds, or an ISO 8601 date-time. Omit for the current time.

name: timestamp_convert
title: Convert a timestamp
